messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
What amount in euro is paid to the verifier for the periodic verification of the 35,000 kg gantry crane at position 23?

response.text: Quale importo in euro viene pagato al verificatore per la verifica periodica della gru a portale da 35.000 kg in posizione 23?
